prompt.alinti: Did you know that cloud can make your CV unrejectable? Most people still pasting their resume in ChatGPT and asking it to make it better. And that's exactly why it's not working.
So before you send another CV into the void and wonder why no one's texting you back or why you're not getting any good offers, try this.
This skill scans your CV like the real applicant tracking system would. Flag the exact section which trip it up and tells you how to fix them.
The skill analyzes your CV against 1,000 similar job descriptions and then gives you the top skills and keywords you're missing.

So this skill rewrites your CV using Google XYZ formula, which is accomplish X measured by Y by doing Z. It applies the top principles which successful applicants use in to land meta, Google, and all the top jobs.
This one turns Claude into the actual hiring manager for your role. It conducts a real-life interviews and asks you the hardest technical questions.
And then rates your answers out of 10. And that is the whole loop. Diagnose, score, rewrite, and prep.
